title: Hook
line: When you close a lead … and you feel like you undersold yourself.
visual: WHY YOU KEEP / UNDERCHARGING. White kicker + big yellow headline; underline draws on 'undersold'.
motion: Kicker words blur in; headline blur-scales in; underline draws on 'undersold'; punch-in on 'undersold'. Exits up with blur.

title: The price slider
line: And because of that, you feel very frustrated.
visual: New construction: a price slider. Yellow knob stuck at LOW, far from a dashed WHAT YOU'RE WORTH marker; a dotted THE GAP line between them. Serif: undersold.
motion: Track fades in; knob nudges in from the left and stops short; worth marker + gap appear; 'undersold.' blurs in on 'frustrated' with a punch-in.

title: Series tile
line: Welcome to Coach Meet Business Series
visual: Paper tile: ep. 04 big top-right; coach meet / business / series (blue bar). Same as ep.01–03.
motion: Words land on the spoken word; tile wipes up to reveal the speaker.

title: 1 crore
line: …what it takes to build a one crore coaching business.
visual: WHAT IT TAKES TO BUILD A / ₹1 CRORE / coaching business. — series signature.
motion: Word-synced kicker; ₹1 CRORE blur-scales in on 'one crore'.

title: The life wheel
line: …the transformation they are about to receive and how it will be impacting their life.
visual: New diagram: a life wheel. White hub THEIR LIFE, six segments with labels in two columns (health, wealth, career | relationships, confidence, peace) light up yellow one by one.
motion: Hub pops on 'transformation'; rim draws; spokes fade in; segments fill in sequence on 'impacting'; labels appear on 'life'.

title: The gap
line: But you quote a very small price, and because of that, you undersell yourself.
visual: Slider callback: knob slides from the middle down to LOW; THE GAP opens to the worth marker. Serif: you undersold yourself.
motion: Knob glides left on 'small price' with a punch-in; gap line reveals; serif line on 'undersell'.

title: Enough
line: …the kind of expertise that I have to solve that problem is enough.
motion: Kicker words on 'expertise … is'; ENOUGH. lands on 'enough' with a punch-in.

title: Belief gauge (low)
line: …because of the belief factor associated with the transformation.
visual: New diagram: a belief gauge. Thin semicircle with ticks, DOUBT ↔ CERTAINTY (yellow zone at the high end); needle sits low. Serif: belief.
motion: Arc draws on 'belief factor'; needle twitches at the low end (hesitation).

title: Belief gauge (high)
line: …the best mechanism … then you become very confident…
visual: Same gauge: needle swung into the yellow CERTAINTY zone. Serif: confident.
motion: Needle rises slowly on 'instill', then swings hard with overshoot on 'best mechanism'; 'confident.' blurs in.

title: High-ticket
line: …confident in quoting a high ticket price.
visual: Slider callback: knob glides all the way to HIGH-TICKET; the gap closes and the worth marker fades (now charging their worth). Serif: with confidence.
motion: Knob travels left→right in 0.85s (power3); HIGH-TICKET label pulses on arrival.

title: B-roll: income
line: …get to the dream income of your coaching business much more faster.
visual: Full-screen graphic cutaway. Dark page; dashed yellow DREAM INCOME line; slow white UNDERCHARGING curve vs steep yellow HIGH-TICKET curve that hits the line first. Big serif: much faster.
motion: Page slides up; axes draw; dream line draws on 'dream income'; slow curve draws slowly, fast curve overtakes it; hit dot pops; 'much faster.' on 'faster'.

title: Absolute clarity
line: …absolute clarity on the transformation across all aspects of life…
visual: Life wheel callback: hub turns yellow ABSOLUTE CLARITY; every segment fills yellow; rim turns yellow.
motion: Wheel fades back in; hub flips on 'clarity'; segments fill in sequence on 'across all aspects of life'.

title: CTA
line: Comment sales and I'm gonna send you a high-ticket sales guide…
visual: COMMENT THE WORD / [S][A][L][E][S] yellow keys / serif: & get the high-ticket sales guide.
motion: Kicker words on 'comment'; keys drop in one after another; serif line on 'high-ticket'.
